$P(x,y)=y,Q(x,y)=-(x+x^2y),$

$$
\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}=2+2xy,
$$

$$
\frac{1}{Q}\left(\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}\right)=-\frac{2}{x},
$$

故积分因子为

$$
\mu(x)=e^{\int -\frac{2}{x}\,dx}=x^{-2}
$$
